revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor. The camera observes a covered loading area with dock equipment, carts, and a wide concrete surface with dull stone flooring and neutral indoor illumination. Moderate side view at near-medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject is an adult with a curvy build wearing a burgundy coat and straight-leg trousers in black and teal clothing, seated normally on a stable office chair with the chair supporting the pelvis and the torso upright. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
